ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure shows a transition-state structure, with R connected to N on the left, and H attached to N; N is connected to the central carbonyl carbon. This carbon forms a double bond downward with O, and is connected to another O to the right; the right-side O is connected to H. There are also curved arrows from :B to H and inside the structure. Then reason: as required, count only bonds whose two endpoints are both not hydrogen, and do not treat curved arrows as bonds. The countable non-hydrogen bonds are R–N, N–C, C=O, C–O. N–H and O–H are excluded because they involve hydrogen, and the arrow of :B is also excluded. Therefore the total is 4.
